Product Details: HIKOKI DV12DE - Cordless Driver Drill, 12V With 10mm Keyless Drill Chuck, Brushless Motor, 2 Speed Gear, 35 Nm Tightening Torque, Built-In Led Light, 1 Kg, 2 Batteries, Charger & Carry Case Included - Distributed/Packaged by Hikoki. Product Details: Brushless Power & Efficiency: Driven by a high-performance 10.8–12V peak brushless motor, this drill delivers up to 35 Nm torque with impressive efficiency. It runs cooler, lasts longer, and reduces maintenance compared to brushed motors—ideal for tough tasks and extended use. Dual-Speed & 20-Stage Clutch Control: Equipped with 2-speed gear settings and a versatile 20-stage clutch, it provides precise torque adjustment for screw-tightening, drilling, and even impact drilling. Perfect for handling a wide range of materials with accuracy and control. Quick-Change 10mm Keyless Chuck: The 10 mm keyless chuck makes bit changes fast, secure, and tool-free. Combined with the 3-mode clutch system, it ensures smooth transitions between applications without interrupting your workflow. LED Lighting & Easy Setup: Work confidently in dark or confined spaces with the built-in LED light for better visibility. Together with the keyless chuck, it simplifies setup so you can stay focused on the job. Lightweight Kit with Smart Battery Indicator: Weighing only 1 kg, it’s compact and easy to use in tight spaces with minimal fatigue. The included battery features a status indicator to monitor charge levels, overheating, or faults—ensuring reliable performance every time.
